subject: Testing

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: coverlet.collector is referenced but CI never collects or publishes coverage

evidence.excerpt:
- name: Test
  run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Run `dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"` in CI and publish the result (reportgenerator step, coverage artifact or Codecov upload) so untested code is visible; no percentage gate is required.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Placeholder Assert.Pass test and tests whose arrange contradicts their name cannot catch the defects they claim to cover (3 tests)
findings.recommendation: Remove the Assert.Pass placeholder (or replace it with a real test), stub a null ErrorMessage and assert the default Warning value, and either build a null-result response or rename the null-result test.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Repository data access is never tested against a real database engine
findings.recommendation: Add an integration test project that runs TestingRepository.ResetTestingAsync against a containerized SQL Server/PostgreSQL (e.g. Testcontainers) with a fresh database per run.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: No fuzz/property-based tests and no DAST job for the HTTP API

evidence.excerpt: steps: checkout, setup-dotnet, restore, build, dotnet test (no DAST or fuzz step)

findings.recommendation: Add an OWASP ZAP API/baseline scan job against the running API in CI, or property-based tests (FsCheck/CsCheck) for input-handling code.

findings.subject: Testing
findings.title: Deployable Web API has no automated load or performance tests

evidence.excerpt:
- name: Test
  run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

findings.recommendation: Add a scripted load test (k6, NBomber or similar) for the API's critical endpoints with pass/fail thresholds, run on a schedule or in the pipeline.

strengths.subject: Testing
strengths.title: CI runs the full test suite on every push and pull request to main, failing the build on test failure

evidence.excerpt: on: push/pull_request branches ["main"] ... run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

strengths.subject: Testing
strengths.title: Unit tests build their own state per test, with no shared setup, sleeps, clock reads or ordering

evidence.excerpt: var mockRepository = new Mock<ITestingRepository>(); ... var service = new TestingService(...);

strengths.subject: Testing
strengths.title: Consistent Unit_Scenario_Expected naming and clear arrange/act/assert, with thorough validation-path tests

notes: Pyramid from inventory totals (unit 9, integration 0, e2e 0, unclassified 4). Bruno collection (test/Bruno) is manually run and only covers GET healthcheck; left out of ratios. TestingShared/TestBase has no test cases (all members commented out). Domain project is DTO-only (exempt from TSR-15); ServicesInjectionExtensions is a composition root (exempt). TST-10: no access control, so STS-01/02/03/06 and TSR-21 N/A; error paths (repository error -> 400 with Warning header, config validation) are tested. TST-13: no retry/timeout/breaker logic visible, so AZT-06/07 not judged; dependency-failure propagation tested at service/controller level; AZT-09 N/A (no fault-injection definitions). TSR-05 not applicable (no coverage threshold configured).
